name: COSPLAY LOVE! Enchanted princess
source:
★Story

The protagonist who works for the company that designs accessories, lately he felt a dead end in his work.
In the beginning of his carrier he was pretty happy that he was assigned to the Product Design Department,
but his design has never been adopted.

One day, he decided to join the event of all and only about cosplay goods,
『Time`s Aegis -Another Mission-』 as a common participant,
in order to remember the origin of his own making of goods and decorations of subculture.
That is where he met this gorgeous girl in a highly complete cosplay costume, and got a chance to talk.
The conversation heated up with the girl who looks just like the ideal of all anime freak,
but his ties with her are supposed to severe at the finale of the event.

Few days have passed since then,
the protagonist, who worked overtime,
was unexpectedly approached by a beautiful girl at a coffee shop in his neighborhood.
To his surprise, she was that beautiful girl who was cosplaying at the event the other day.

“Please be my TA-loving cosplay friend!”
said she.

"In this stream of time, we have met again.
Then this must be fate, isn't it?"

Here starts the cosplay-love story between the newbie designer and mademoiselle!

Source https://imel.co.jp/confiture_20220311_1/
translation:
★故事

就职于配饰设计公司的主人公，最近感觉工作陷入了死胡同。
刚入职之初，他很高兴被分配到产品设计部，
但他的设计从未被采用。

有一天，他决定参加一场只有cosplay商品的活动，
“时间之盾-另一个使命-”作为共同参与者，
为了记住他自己制作的亚文化商品和装饰品的起源。
在那里，他遇到了这个穿着高度完整的cosplay服装的漂亮女孩，并有机会交谈。
与这个看起来就像所有动漫迷的理想女孩的谈话变得激烈，
但他和她的关系应该会在活动的结局中变得更加紧密。

从那时起已经过去几天了，
加班的主角，
在他家附近的一家咖啡店里，一位美丽的女孩意外地接近了他。
让他惊讶的是，她就是前几天活动中cosplay的那个漂亮女孩。

“请成为我喜欢TA的cosplay朋友吧！”
她说。

“在这时间的长流中，我们又见面了。
那么这一定就是命运，不是吗？”

新人设计师与小姐的cosplay爱情故事就此展开！
